study: D4: zero-mean fluctuations, mean momentum flux, and mean force
units: dimensionless Cartesian periodic examples; no physical calibration

scope.constant_average: normalized integral over the full 2pi by 2pi torus
scope.envelope_average: normalized x integral at fixed y
scope.stress_sign: Q_ij = mean(w_i*w_j), positive momentum covariance per unit density
scope.mean_force_sign: F_i = -sum_j partial_j Q_ij on the right side of the mean momentum equation
scope.pressure_convention: pressure divided by density; p=-a(y)^2/2 cancels the vertical wave force
scope.spatial_derivatives: Fourier differentiation on endpoint-excluded periodic grids; even-grid Nyquist derivative set to zero
scope.errors: float64 max component absolute errors unless explicitly marked Frobenius-relative; no display floor in exported data
